title: fix(service-automation): RESUME_CHILD_PENDING's remedy names every run of the suspension chain
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XD327LjMjJZx2oCbKfZMtNc)_

Fixes #28202

Clause-②: no (message wording only)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：批处理（`map`）运行的子项运行已消失、又没有 `cancelled` 历史时，恢复会被 `RESUME_CHILD_PENDING`（409）拒绝；拒绝文字里「要结束这批，请取消哪些运行」现在列出整条挂起链上的每一个运行，从 map 自己的运行起，依次往上，直到被恢复的那个运行。
- **为什么改**：卡 #28202（分诊 6528511645，来自 PR #28176 合同评审 S3/S4）：取消一个运行不会连带取消等它的运行。map 在被恢复运行之下隔了不止一层 `subflow:` 时，旧文字只点名两头，运维照做后中间那层仍然挂着。
- **风险与回滚**：只改文字。错误码、状态码和合同文字都不变；两层链的文字与改前逐字相同。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/services/service-automation/src/run-resume.ts`（新函数 `waitingRunsClause` 和它在 `continuePastCancelledMapItem` 里的唯一调用处）；`packages/services/service-automation/src/map-cancelled-item-resume.test.ts`（新增两层、三层两条用例）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/map-cancelled-item-resume.test.ts` → `Tests 9 passed (9)`。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`continuePastCancelledMapItem` ended its remedy with "To end the batch, cancel run 'MAP'", plus " and run 'RESUMED', which waits on it" when nested. It named `link.runId` and the resumed `runId` only. The `chain` it already receives (from `resolveSuspensionChain`, bounded by `MAX_SUSPENSION_CHAIN_DEPTH` = 32) holds every link, so the new helper `waitingRunsClause(chain)` names every run above the map, nearest first:

| Chain | Remedy tail |
| :--- | :--- |
| MAP resumed directly | `cancel run 'MAP'` (unchanged) |
| OUTER → MAP | `cancel run 'MAP' and run 'OUTER', which waits on it` (unchanged, byte for byte) |
| OUTER → MID → MAP | `cancel run 'MAP' and runs 'MID' and 'OUTER', which wait on it in turn` |
| deeper | `cancel run 'MAP' and runs 'A', 'B' and 'OUTER', which wait on it in turn` |

The list needs no cap of its own: the chain walk's depth bound already bounds it. The code (`RESUME_CHILD_PENDING`), the 409 status, the log line and every other sentence of the message are unchanged. `refuseMapItemSkip` (the still-suspended item) names one run to resume, not runs to cancel, so it is untouched.

## Tests

Two new cases in `map-cancelled-item-resume.test.ts`, inside the existing `#27971` describe and its fixtures:

- **two-level** (OUTER → MAP, item row gone, history `paused`): pins the nested suffix `To end the batch, cancel run 'MAP' and run 'OUTER', which waits on it; `, plus code and nothing moved. Card S4 noted this suffix was not pinned before.
- **three-level** (OUTER → MID → MAP): pins `... cancel run 'MAP' and runs 'MID' and 'OUTER', which wait on it in turn; `, code, and that the map state and all three suspensions are unchanged.

The two direct pins (`To end the batch, cancel run '${paused.runId}'`, ≈L183/L200) are untouched and green.

<details><summary>Red first on origin/main 1f1a369b (test only, no fix)</summary>

```
× names every run of a three-level chain in the remedy, from the map up to the resumed run
Received: "... Nothing was changed. To end the batch, cancel run 'run_6e14…' and run 'run_2655…', which waits on it; if the run history store was unreachable, retry once it is readable"
Tests  1 failed | 8 passed (9)
```
The base names MAP and OUTER only; MID is missing. The two-level case is green on the base (its text is unchanged).
</details>

<details><summary>Green and package suite</summary>

- `vitest run src/map-cancelled-item-resume.test.ts` → `Tests 9 passed (9)`, exit 0.
- Under the verify lock: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation build && … typecheck && … test` → `Test Files 249 passed (249)`, `Tests 3164 passed (3164)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `eslint packages/services/service-automation --no-inline-config` → exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (on the fix, committed before the mutation)</summary>

Restored the two-name form through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --hold` on `run-resume.ts` (injected-text count 1, removed-text count 0 on disk). The test imports `./run-resume.js` from `src/` relatively, so no `dist/` build sits on the path. Result: `× names every run of a three-level chain …`, `Tests 1 failed | 8 passed (9)`: the three-level case only. Restored with `--restore` + `git checkout HEAD -- PATH`; `git diff HEAD` empty and the file's hash equals the `HEAD` blob (`3db6ab0c`).
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The message's lead still says "Run 'OUTER' is waiting on run 'MAP'" in a three-level chain, which is true transitively. The card scoped the change to the remedy, so the lead is left as is.
